column1: # INLINE MARKERS.
# Written in a page as   [some text]{.marker}   or bare as   {.marker}
# EVERY ROW BELONGS TO A CLASS (theme/marker-classes.tsv), and the class supplies
# the default shape and colour. Read that file first -- it is where the families
# are defined and where the reasoning lives.
# ADDING ONE IS A ROW HERE. No code change, no CSS change.
# EVERY USE IS COUNTED IN THE BUILD REPORT, GROUPED BY CLASS. That is the actual
# point -- a marker nobody can list is just a colour. It is what lets you ask
# "what is unconfirmed across this whole site" and get an answer, and grouping by
# class is what keeps that answer clean now that not every marker is a confidence
# claim. A terminology marker used three hundred times must not drown the six
# rows that mean something is unverified.
# COLUMNS
# marker   the token you type: {.tbc}
# class    which family this belongs to. REQUIRED. See marker-classes.tsv.
# label    shown when used bare, with no text of its own
# shape    OVERRIDE the class shape. Blank = inherit.
#          box · plain · strike · soft
# color    OVERRIDE the class colour. Blank = inherit -- and inheriting is the
#          better path: the class colour is a generated CSS rule, so one cell
#          repaints the whole family, where an override is inline on every span.
# tooltip  hover text. Say what the READER should DO about it.
# ⭐ SHAPE AND COLOUR ARE SEPARATE AXES, and that split is the whole flexibility.
# Shape is structural -- does this thing have a border, is it struck out -- and
# there are only FOUR because a reader can distinguish four shapes at a glance and
# cannot distinguish nine. Colour is free. Any shape works with any colour, so a
# boxed green confirmation and a boxed amber warning are the same mechanism
# wearing different paint.
#   box     bordered chip, tinted background. Demands attention.
#   plain   coloured text, no chrome. Present but not shouting.
#   strike  struck through. Superseded, kept findable.
#   soft    italic, prefixed with ~. Approximate rather than doubtful.
# ✅ THE CLASS AXIS COST THE SHAPE AXIS NOTHING. Terminology needed colour and
# weight WITHOUT an underline, which is exactly `plain` -- it was already there.
# Four shapes still cover every family.
# ⚠️ PREFER INHERITING, THEN A TOKEN, AND ONLY THEN A HEX. A token follows the
# theme into light mode and into every other site; a hex is frozen where you typed
# it and will be wrong on the scheme you were not looking at. Hex is supported
# because it is genuinely useful for a one-off, not because it is the good path.
# ⚠️ THE BOX SHAPE MEANS A COLOUR HAS TO SURVIVE ITS OWN BACKGROUND. `box` tints
# the chip with 10% of the marker's own colour, so the text is not sitting on the
# page ground -- it is sitting on a wash of itself. A value measured only against
# the page can still fail inside the chip, and three amber candidates did exactly
# that on 2026-08-05. Measure the chip, not the page.
# 🔴 `conf` AND `gap` MOVED TO CANONICAL TOKEN NAMES ON 2026-08-05, and it is not
# a rename. `ok` and `danger` exist ONLY in the nine-token stand-in, so a
# confirmed value and a known gap were being painted by a table nobody maintains
# while every other colour on the page followed the design system. `good` and
# `bad` are the canonical names for the same two meanings, and they were
# unreachable until the validator learned to read both tables.
